history.title: Our History
history.p1: Founded in 2009 in Luxembourg, INVIK SA was born from a bold vision to redefine the banking experience for the digital age. Our founders, experts in finance and technology, identified a crucial need: offering modern banking services without compromising security or human relationships.
history.p2: Since our beginnings, we have experienced remarkable growth, going from a few hundred clients to over 500,000 active users across Europe. This expansion testifies to our constant commitment to innovation and customer service excellence.
history.p3: Today, INVIK SA is recognized as one of the most reliable and innovative online banks in Europe, with an established presence in Luxembourg, France, Belgium, and Germany.

items.question: How can I open an account with INVIK SA?
items.answer: To open an account, go to our registration page, complete the form with your personal information, then follow the steps to verify your identity and validate your file.

items.question: How can I make an international transfer?
items.answer: International transfers are made from your client area by choosing the "International Transfer" option. Enter your beneficiary's details, the amount and currency, then validate the operation after verifying the information.

items.question: What documents are required for account opening?
items.answer: You will generally need a valid ID (passport, ID card) and proof of address less than three months old. Additional documents may be requested depending on your situation.

items.question: Is my information secure at INVIK SA?
items.answer: Yes. INVIK SA uses advanced encryption technologies and security protocols to protect your personal and financial data, as well as your online operations.

items.question: How can I order an INVIK SA bank card?
items.answer: Once your account is open, you can request a bank card directly from your online client area, in the "My Cards" section, then follow the instructions for ordering and activation.

items.question: What are the payment and withdrawal limits of my INVIK SA cards?
items.answer: Each INVIK SA card has default payment and withdrawal limits (per day and/or month). These limits may vary depending on your profile, card type, and history. You can view and adjust your limits, up to authorized amounts, directly from your client area or our app.

items.question: Does INVIK SA offer loan solutions?
items.answer: Yes, INVIK SA offers several types of loans, including personal loans and financing solutions adapted to your projects, subject to conditions and acceptance. Consult our "Our Services" page for more details.

items.question: What are the withdrawal fees at ATMs?
items.answer: Withdrawals may be free up to a certain amount or number of operations per month, then charged according to the current fee schedule. Fees may differ between withdrawals made in the Eurozone and internationally. Consult the "Rates" section of your client area.

items.question: What fees are associated with INVIK SA accounts?
items.answer: Our fees are designed to be transparent and competitive. You can consult all rates (account maintenance, cards, operations, etc.) on our dedicated fee schedule page.

items.question: How to contact INVIK SA customer service?
items.answer: Our customer service is available to assist you. You can contact us by phone, email, or via the contact form or online chat, according to the channels indicated on our "Contact" page.

items.question: Can I manage my INVIK SA account from a mobile?
items.answer: Yes, our platform is optimized for use on mobile, tablet, and computer. You can view your balances, track your operations, and manage your services wherever you are.

items.question: What to do if my INVIK SA card is lost or stolen?
items.answer: In case of loss or theft, immediately block your card from your client area, if available, and/or contact our customer service immediately to oppose the card and request a replacement.

items.question: Which countries are eligible for a credit at INVIK bank?
items.answer: INVIK bank offers credits to residents of all European countries (Eurozone, EU, Switzerland, UK, etc.) and Americas (USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, etc.). To be eligible, you must have a valid passport, prove identity, and justify regular income.

privacy.title: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy.intro_1: At INVIK SA, we attach paramount importance to the privacy and security of the personal data of our users and clients. This privacy policy describes how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you use our site and online services.
privacy.intro_2: INVIK SA acts in compliance with applicable regulations regarding personal data protection, notably the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). By accessing our services, you acknowledge having read this policy and agree to accept it.

sections.title: 1. What data do we collect and for what purposes?
sections.text: We collect only the information necessary for the provision, management, and improvement of our services, as well as for compliance with our legal and regulatory obligations. Depending on the case, the categories of data we may process are:
list: Identification data: name, first name, date of birth, nationality, country of residence, contact details (address, phone, email), profession.
Contact and exchange data: information transmitted via forms (contact, credit request, account opening) and exchanges with our customer service.
Financial and banking relationship data: information relating to your accounts, operations, credit requests, declared income and other data necessary for the study and management of your file.
Navigation and technical data: IP address, browser type, pages viewed, timestamp of visits, to ensure site security, prevent fraud and improve user experience.
sections.text_after: This data may be collected directly from you (forms, exchanges with our team) or, where applicable, via authorized sources (for example, when the law requires certain verifications).

sections.title: 2. Legal bases, retention period and data sharing
sections.text: The processing of your personal data by INVIK SA relies, depending on the situation, on several legal bases: the execution of pre-contractual measures or a contract, compliance with legal and regulatory obligations, the legitimate interest of INVIK SA or, when required, your consent.

subsections.title: Retention period
subsections.text: We keep your personal data for a period not exceeding that necessary for the purposes for which they are collected, increased where applicable by legal prescription periods or retention obligations imposed by regulations.

subsections.title: Data sharing
subsections.text: INVIK SA does not sell your personal data. However, they may be communicated to the following categories of recipients:
list: Internal services of INVIK SA authorized to process your request.
Technical providers and partners intervening on behalf of INVIK SA (hosting, security tools).
Administrative, judicial or supervisory authorities, when the law requires it.

subsections.title: Security measures
subsections.text: INVIK SA implements appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against loss, unauthorized access or disclosure:
list: Use of secure hosting solutions and firewalls.
Access controls and limitation of data to authorized persons only.
Internal security procedures and regular audits.

sections.title: 3. Your rights, cookies and how to contact us

subsections.title: Your rights regarding your data
subsections.text: In accordance with regulations, you have the following rights:
list: Right of access, rectification and erasure of your data.
Right to restriction of processing and right to object.
Right to data portability, where applicable.
subsections.text_after: You can exercise these rights by contacting us by email at: contact-inviksa@monsupport-app.com.

subsections.title: Cookies and trackers
subsections.text: During your navigation, cookies may be placed on your terminal to ensure the proper functioning of the site and for statistical purposes. You can manage your preferences via your browser settings.

subsections.title: Questions and complaints
subsections.text: If you have questions regarding this policy, you can contact us via our online form or by email. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

support.title: Assistance & Support
support.subtitle: Consult online help or chat with an advisor.

q1.a: A classic SEPA transfer generally takes 1 to 2 business days. If you are waiting for an international transfer, it can take up to 5 days. Check that the provided IBAN is correct.

q2.a: You can view your current limits in the 'Cards' section. For a temporary or permanent increase, please contact your advisor via a support ticket.

q3.a: Always activate two-factor authentication (2FA). Never share your codes received by SMS. In case of doubt on a transaction, immediately block your card from the app.

q4.a: Our rates are transparent. The standard account is free. Maintenance fees for premium accounts are debited monthly. Consult our fee schedule in 'Documents'.

q5.a: Click on 'Forgotten password' on the login page. A reset link will be sent to you by email instantly.
